_comment: Trading Log registry. Newest first. Rebuild the index and the front-page teaser with: python build-trading-log.py. Register a new entry page (root HTML tagged tile-variant=trading-log) with: python build-trading-log.py --add <file.html>. 'url' is the branded address the row links to; 'source' is the Pages copy (null for entries stored only in Base44). 'time' is the UK time the note went live.

entries.title: Crest Nicholson: worse figures, same asset case
entries.why: Profit guidance cut again and the covenant timetable slips, but net debt is £30m better than guided. My 160.97p asset valuation is unchanged.

entries.title: A tech jitter, not a turning point
entries.why: The NASDAQ off around 2.6% overnight and Korea hit hard, but the names at the centre of it were not expensive going in. A positioning flush, not a re-rating.

entries.companies: Berkeley, Barratt Redrow, Bellway, Vistry, Taylor Wimpey, Persimmon, Crest Nicholson
entries.title: Barclays housebuilder sector note: the "second wave" cost inflation warning
entries.why: Barclays downgrades several UK housebuilders on a second wave of cost inflation, with price targets cut 26% to 49%. Berkeley is the sole overweight. The market barely moved.

entries.title: Buying the Nasdaq at support: a small bet that the storm passes
entries.why: The Nasdaq has bounced off the same support three times in three weeks. A small long at 24,373 with a tight stop at 24,139.
